# Corrected claim — screening colonoscopy billed as diagnostic

**Use when:** a screening colonoscopy converted to diagnostic/therapeutic and the claim
went out without the screening indicator. Patient gets billed cost-sharing they should
not owe, and complains. **This is a corrected claim, not an appeal** — faster and
cleaner.

## The rule
A screening colonoscopy that becomes diagnostic **retains its screening status** for
patient cost-sharing under the ACA preventive-services provision.

| Payer | Modifier | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Medicare | **PT** | Screening converted to diagnostic — waives deductible |
| Commercial | **33** | Preventive service — waives cost-sharing |

Medicare screening HCPCS: **G0121** (average risk), **G0105** (high risk).
Converted procedures bill the therapeutic CPT (e.g. 45380, 45385) **+ PT**.

## Checklist
- [ ] Confirm the order/indication was **screening**, not diagnostic (chart, not claim)
- [ ] Confirm nothing else already waived cost-sharing
- [ ] Append **PT** (Medicare) or **33** (commercial) to the therapeutic CPT
- [ ] Diagnosis sequencing: screening Z-code (**Z12.11**) first, findings secondary
- [ ] Submit as a **corrected claim** (837 CLM05-3 = 7, reference original payer claim #)
- [ ] Re-run the patient statement — refund any cost-share already collected

## Corrected-claim cover note
> Corrected claim. The original submission omitted modifier [PT/33]. This was a
> screening [colonoscopy] (indication [Z12.11]) that converted to therapeutic when
> [findings]. Under [Medicare preventive policy / ACA § 2713] the service retains
> screening status for cost-sharing. Please reprocess and adjust patient
> responsibility accordingly. Original claim #: [NUMBER].
